name: agents/verify-triage
objective: classify a failed verify step and choose the repair loop's next move, without paying for an LLM

failure.description: what kind of failure the verify log shows

next.description: what the build agent should do next

caused_by_change.description: whether the change under test caused the failure

progress.description: whether repeated repair attempts are converging

questions.ask: What kind of failure does this verify log show?
What should the build agent do next: retry unchanged, fix the code, fix the environment, or escalate to a human?
Was this failure caused by the code change under test, rather than the environment?
Across the attempts so far, is the repair loop making progress toward passing?
